actions.title: Read the withheld lesson boundary
actions.instruction: Future private-source walkthrough only: read this source lesson without trying to run it. Preview 0.25 does not publish F03, so its Prepare, Check, and Reset routes refuse this lesson.
actions.rationale: A checked-in draft and a published guided lesson are different product states.
actions.expected_result: You know that Preview 0.25 does not publish F03 and that Prepare, Check, and Reset refuse it today.
actions.recovery: If a current Preview 0.25 command offers to run F03, stop and preserve its output because that contradicts the release boundary.
actions.evidence: Future private-source walkthrough only. The Preview 0.25 manifest remains the authority for current public availability.

actions.title: Understand the future prepared attempt
actions.instruction: Future private-source walkthrough only: a later release may prepare a numbered F03 attempt with academy.docs.0001 queued and docs/ticket-list-contract.md seeded. There is no current F03 Prepare command to copy from this card.
actions.rationale: The prepared commit must bind the original board line and contract sentence before learner work begins.
actions.expected_result: Preview 0.25 refuses F03 Prepare; the future attempt described here would start from one clean prepared commit.
actions.recovery: Do not synthesize the fixture or bypass the refusal. Wait for a release that publishes F03.
actions.evidence: A future prepared commit would establish the comparison base. This source card does not create one.

actions.title: Read the bounded docs task
actions.instruction: Future private-source walkthrough only: on a supported prepared attempt, read academy.docs.0001 and its continuation lines before changing anything. Its boundary is docs/ticket-list-contract.md, and the task must remain in progress.
actions.rationale: The exact task text defines the work file, evidence, and prohibition on completing the task in this lesson.
actions.expected_result: The prepared board shows academy.docs.0001 as [ ] and names docs/ticket-list-contract.md as its sole work boundary.
actions.recovery: If the task is absent, already started, completed, or points elsewhere, stop. Do not substitute another task or edit the board by hand.
actions.evidence: The prepared task line and continuation fields identify the future exercise boundary.

actions.title: Start the docs task through CodeArbiter
actions.instruction: Future private-source walkthrough only: in a supported prepared attempt, use the host-native task command to start academy.docs.0001. This is an agent command, not a shell command.
actions.rationale: The task writer owns the canonical [~] transition and started date.
actions.expected_result: The task writer changes academy.docs.0001 from [ ] to [~], adds the real started date, and leaves its text unchanged.
actions.recovery: If the command blocks, preserve its message and stop. Do not imitate the transition with a direct board edit.
actions.evidence: The durable board state can later be inspected, but it cannot authenticate which agent command produced it.

actions.title: Inspect the in-progress transition
actions.instruction: Future private-source walkthrough only: inspect the task writer's diff before starting the docs chore. Confirm that only academy.docs.0001 moved to [~] with a started date.
actions.rationale: The board transition must ride the work commit, so it remains unstaged and uncommitted at this point.
actions.expected_result: The board diff contains one queued-to-started line change for academy.docs.0001, and no commit exists after Prepare yet.
actions.recovery: If another task or continuation line changed, stop before the docs lane. Preserve the diff for diagnosis.
actions.evidence: The reviewed unstaged diff shows the candidate board half of the future co-commit.

actions.title: Read the exact contract correction
actions.instruction: Future private-source walkthrough only: read docs/ticket-list-contract.md. The bounded correction replaces its false sentence with: Ticket list output shows the claimant for a claimed ticket and no claimant for an open ticket.
actions.rationale: The docs chore needs one exact factual correction, not a broad rewrite or implementation change.
actions.expected_result: You can state the one replacement sentence and the rule it records: claimed tickets show a claimant; open tickets do not.
actions.recovery: If the prepared sentence already differs, stop. Do not adapt the correction to a different document version.
actions.evidence: The prepared document supplies the original byte boundary for the future Check.

actions.title: Run the real docs chore
actions.instruction: Future private-source walkthrough only: invoke the host-native docs chore. When the host asks for scope, supply only the approved claimant-visibility correction in docs/ticket-list-contract.md. Keep academy.docs.0001 at [~].
actions.rationale: The docs lane applies its normal review, anti-slop, commit-gate, and branch-completion workflow to the bounded correction.

variants.command: /ca:chore docs Correct claimant visibility in docs/ticket-list-contract.md
$ca-chore docs Correct claimant visibility in docs/ticket-list-contract.md
/ca-chore docs Correct claimant visibility in docs/ticket-list-contract.md
/skill:ca-chore docs Correct claimant visibility in docs/ticket-list-contract.md

actions.expected_result: The host changes only the contract sentence, preserves the in-progress board transition, and pauses for review before its normal commit gate.
actions.recovery: If the host proposes code, task completion, another document, or release metadata, stop the chore and preserve the current diff.
actions.evidence: The later commit can prove the resulting repository boundary, not that this agent command ran.

actions.title: Review the staged co-commit
actions.instruction: Future private-source walkthrough only: when the docs chore pauses before commit, review the staged path list and staged diff. Authorize its commit gate only if .codearbiter/open-tasks.md and docs/ticket-list-contract.md are the complete staged path set, the task remains [~], and the document contains only the approved sentence replacement.
actions.rationale: Starting the task and doing its bounded work belong in one commit. A board-only commit or a document-only commit breaks that rule.
actions.expected_result: The reviewed staged boundary contains exactly two paths and will become one commit: the [~] board transition plus docs/ticket-list-contract.md.
actions.recovery: If a path is missing or extra, or if academy.docs.0001 is [x], do not authorize the commit gate. Keep the staged state visible for correction.
actions.evidence: The learner reviews the exact staged co-commit before authorizing the docs lane to continue.

actions.title: Keep the attempt branch local
actions.instruction: Future private-source walkthrough only: after the docs chore's normal commit gate succeeds and its branch-completion handoff appears, choose Keep the branch as-is (I'll handle it later).
actions.rationale: The future Academy attempt needs its local evidence branch intact and does not need remote publication.
actions.expected_result: The numbered attempt stays checked out and clean with one local co-commit, no push, and no hosted pull request.
actions.recovery: Do not choose merge, push, pull request, or discard. If another option already ran, stop and preserve the resulting state.
actions.evidence: The local branch and commit remain available; no hosted pull request is created or claimed.

actions.title: Confirm the one-commit result
actions.instruction: Future private-source walkthrough only: inspect status, the latest commit, and its changed paths after choosing Keep the branch as-is.
actions.rationale: The future Check requires one post-Prepare commit, the exact two-path co-commit, and no non-ignored worktree state.

variants.command:
git status --short
git log --oneline --decorate -1
git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r HEAD

git status --short
git log --oneline --decorate -1
git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r HEAD

git status --short
git log --oneline --decorate -1
git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r HEAD

actions.expected_result: Status is empty, and the only post-Prepare commit changes .codearbiter/open-tasks.md and docs/ticket-list-contract.md.
actions.recovery: If status is not clean or history has another learner commit, preserve the branch. Do not amend, squash, reset, or delete evidence.
actions.evidence: The one post-Prepare commit and no non-ignored worktree state form the durable local result.

actions.title: Understand the future Check boundary
actions.instruction: Future private-source walkthrough only: a later published F03 Check will compare prepared and committed Git state. There is no current F03 Check command to copy from this card.
actions.rationale: Repository evidence can validate content and history without claiming agent telemetry.
actions.expected_result: Preview 0.25 refuses F03 Check. A future Check would accept only the exact one-commit, two-path, clean result with academy.docs.0001 still [~].
actions.recovery: Do not manufacture a Check result. Keep the local branch unchanged until F03 is published.
actions.evidence: A future Check can inspect board bytes, document bytes, commit topology, commit date, changed paths, and worktree cleanliness. It cannot prove `$ca-task` ran and cannot prove `$ca-chore` ran.

actions.title: Understand the future retry boundary
actions.instruction: Future private-source walkthrough only: a later published Reset may archive a failed F03 attempt before creating a new numbered attempt. There is no current F03 Reset command to copy from this card.
actions.rationale: A new attempt must preserve failed evidence instead of rewriting the one-commit history.
actions.expected_result: Preview 0.25 refuses F03 Reset. No retry occurs from this source-only lesson.
actions.recovery: Keep the branch as-is. Do not force-reset, rebase, delete it, or imitate Academy attempt bookkeeping.
actions.evidence: The current local branch remains the only available evidence until a published F03 lifecycle exists.
